channel.title: RuPaul's Drag Race UK vs the World
channel.desc: The fierce Drag Race UK spin-off continues as our international queens fight to impress Mama Ru and do their countries proud. Award-winning comedian Jayde Adams is on hand to help as for one night only the queens form comedy double acts for RuPaul's Fringe Festival. But who will have the last laugh? Amandaland star Lucy Punch joins RuPaul on the judging panel alongside Michelle Visage and Graham Norton as another queen sashays away.
